svg.title: A dangling `href` does not suppress a valid `path`

html:meta.name: assert
html:meta.content: The href prose says the element is in error and its entire contents are not rendered when the reference is invalid and the attribute is used, but the same paragraph opens by saying href names the path only if no path attribute is provided. So a present-but-unused href is not used, its invalidity is not an error, and the text renders along the inline data. Measured 2026-09-08: Chrome 155 and Firefox 157 both render along the inline path.
